items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they were having the meetings at Abdullah Buhaina’s house, who was formally Art Blakey.

ctx.x: [laughing] And he said, “Well, I’m practicing Islam, you know, through the Ahmadiyya Movement in Islam.” I said, “Oh yeah?” He said, “Yeah.” So...and he happened to live around the corner from me–he was traveling, he was an itinerant person at the time. So, we went home, and I went by his house and he gave me some literature, which is printed by the Ahmadiyya Movement in Islam. Um and this is a movement which was founded by Mirza Ghulam Ahmad of Qadian [India] um...in 1889. So, I began to read the literature…
